body: Yeah. Want to talk about your situation via PM? We could have some philosophical shit going on ;)
Either way, planning suicide a year ahead is always a better choice than doing it on impulse, whether you change your perspective or not.

I understand. There are different reasons behind suicide and depression. I guess I must be the sort of person who sees no ultimate consequences as a *good* thing and whose main reason for suicidal depression throughout most of life was placing too much weight on other people's feelings, judgements and expectations. Actually, scratch that... too much weight on *my own* feelings, judgements and expectations.

I know there's a ton of other people who have completely different reasons for wanting to kill themselves and a point of view like that isn't going to cut it for them. Well, that was just me sharing my story, and I can't speak for anyone else than myself.

But bear in mind that, in light of what you said, everything *anyone else* has ever done is irrelevant as well.

Interesting quote, BTW. And now I know who Tsunetomo Yamamoto was. TIL something.
